note: Modules the Wine runtime provides as builtins (dlls/*), minus the ones the iOS build does not ship. "modules" is the 32-bit (WoW64, i386 farm) set; "modules_64" is what the 64-bit ARM64EC farm (app/Madeira/arm64ec-windows) actually holds, and "not_in_64bit_farm" the rest, which a 64-bit program cannot load. An import matching the list for its architecture needs no compatibility entry; one in "not_shipped" (or, for a 64-bit program, in "not_in_64bit_farm") does not exist here and is reported.
